context.transcript:
Hi, Aaron.
I just got out of my meeting with Janet Lin from Product Development.
She liked our design for the company's new line of raincoats, but unfortunately, she wants us to use different colors than what we proposed.
I tried my best to convince her that a fresh, new look was needed, but she insisted on a more traditional approach.
There wasn't much more I could do.
You know... she's the head of the department.
Anyway, I'm back at my desk now, so I'm going to find a time on our calendars tomorrow when we can get together and start on these changes.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Aaron。
我刚结束和产品开发部门的 Janet Lin 的会议。
她喜欢我们公司新系列雨衣的设计，但很遗憾，她希望我们使用与我们提议的不同颜色。
我尽力说服她需要一个清新、全新的外观，但她坚持采用更传统的做法。
我能做的已经不多了。
你知道……她是部门负责人。
无论如何，我现在回到了我的办公桌前，所以我要在我们的日程表上找个时间，我们明天聚一下，开始处理这些修改。
